PRODUCTS_UPSERT_SQL: insert into products (id, name, price_vnd, description, url, lang, source) values (%(id)s, %(name)s, %(price_vnd)s, %(description)s, %(url)s, %(lang)s, %(source)s) on conflict (id) do update set name = excluded.name, price_vnd = excluded.price_vnd, description = excluded.description, url = excluded.url, lang = excluded.lang, retired_at = null, updated_at = now() where products.source = excluded.source and (products.name, products.price_vnd, products.description, products.url, products.lang, products.retired_at) is distinct from (excluded.name, excluded.price_vnd, excluded.description, excluded.url, excluded.lang, null)
PRODUCTS_RETIRE_SQL: update products p set retired_at = now(), updated_at = now() where p.source = %s and p.retired_at is null and p.id <> all(%s) returning p.id, p.name, p.url, (select count(*) from orders o where o.product_id = p.id and o.source <> 'sample' and o.source not like 'sample:%%')
PLOTS_DELETE_SQL: delete from plots p where source = %s and not (exists (select 1 from plot_logs l where l.plot_id = p.id and l.row_hash is not null) or exists (select 1 from garden_media m where m.plot_id = p.id))
PLOTS_UPSERT_SUFFIX: on conflict (id) do update set location = excluded.location, area_m2 = excluded.area_m2, variety = excluded.variety, tree_count = excluded.tree_count, planted_year = excluded.planted_year, status = excluded.status, updated_at = now() where plots.source = excluded.source
